title: Sharp steady growth rate of the five-place branch systems
claim: Does every branch system in DEAD-CAP's within-five class have steady growth at most the eleven-junction theta rate?
standard_statement: Dominate the nonnegative branch series of each admissible finite initial piece within five places, including spare pendant points and rays. Prove a sharp bound on the exponential coefficient rate (limsup, hence also steady rates), using the named source's class boundary.
prior_work: DEAD-CAP proves the branch equations and rank classification, with precise exclusions S0/S3/S4/S6′. Its fastest sampled theta was compared numerically and equality was conjectured. WALL-READ points to the uniform comparison.
source_contribution: All original three-place and two-place block branch equations bounded at the positive theta singularity; handle ends and isolated 4/5-blocks, exact attainment, scopes.
remaining_obligations: Proof bounding every within-five branch system by 2.382975... or an explicit faster start.
completion_gate: Prove each scoped assertion and report unrestricted status.
